HS17003A Toggle Switch to select between two modes of Cascade control for FIC17003:

ON = Floc consumption (F72PP691_Parameter_1) input into F72CALC10013 derived from CRO input 
OFF = Floc consumption (F72PP691_Parameter_1) input into F72CALC10013 derived from Manta Sub (vendor)

Refer to Calculation F72CALC10013 for further details.

notes:

If F72PP667 selected, enable FIC72123 output to F72PP668
